thread:
incident-bot: Pager — HIGH severity: model-warmup failures in us-west-2, multiple nodes flapping due to CUDA OOM during deserialization. Affected pool: ded-gpu-rt-4.

maria.castaneda: Seeing repeated OOMs on warmup for rdw/opt-13b-q4a. Node crashes when trying to deserialize shard 2/4. Metrics spike at 12:05 UTC.

samir.patel: logs (truncated):
```
[2026-03-15T12:04:58Z] ERROR runtime: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[2026-03-15T12:04:58Z] WARN warmup: deserializing shard=2 artifact=opt-13b-q4a size=9.3G
[2026-03-15T12:05:00Z] FATAL: container crash: signal SIGABRT
```

natalie: A few followups: is this on a single instance type? or across sizes?

maria.castaneda: It started on p4d.xlarge-8 but now also on p4d.2x where we usually have room. Possibly fragmentation + compile cache causing bursts.

kai: Noted. Is compile timeout related? any "kernel compile timeout" in logs?

samir.patel: yes one line: `compile_cache: kernel compile timeout after 30s` right before OOM. suspecting JIT/kernels triggering larger transient allocations.

ashok: Marking customer-impact: high for two customers on dedicated pools (ids C-112, C-338). Their requests are failing with 503s during warmup. Support pinging them.

support-bot: Support escalation created: INC-2026-2041. Support team to send initial comms once we have ETA.

maria.castaneda: Mitigation plan I propose:
1) hotfix: disable warmup-compile step (env VAR: REDWOOD_DISABLE_COMPILE=1) for ded-gpu-rt-4
2) disable concurrent warmup threads: MODEL_WARMUP_THREADS=1
3) temporarily divert new allocations to ded-gpu-rt-2 (capacity free)
4) rollback artifact to opt-13b-q4a@rev-2 (smaller shard layout)

samir.patel: executing step 1 & 2 on a single node now. applying with /ops/run:
```
kubectl set env ds/ded-warmup REDWOOD_DISABLE_COMPILE=1 MODEL_WARMUP_THREADS=1 -n redwood-inference
```

infra-oncall: acknowledging handoff — I'm watching the pool and will stop rollouts to it. I'll also raise node taints to prevent new pods if instability continues.

(30m later)

maria.castaneda: After disabling compile, warmups still fail but OOMs reduced. One node still crashed during shard load; we evicted two pods and restarted service.

samir.patel: Rolled back artifact for two affected customers. Their warmups succeeded on new artifact. Monitoring.

natalie: Any perf regressions expected with compile disabled? Might increase latency for first requests.

maria.castaneda: Small increase in first-request time (~250ms) but steady-state unaffected. Preferable to crashes.

ashok: Customer comms draft (support): "We've identified a runtime warmup issue impacting model loads in us-west-2. We've applied mitigations and rolled back to a stable artifact. You may see slightly longer first requests; no data loss. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline for full fix."

kai: Next steps for engineering:
- Capture full kernel compile traces and reproduce locally with synthetic warmup
- Add guard to limit transient JIT allocation peaks
- Consider precompiled kernels for opt-13b family
- Add shapshotting of deserialized memory layout to detect fragmentation

maria.castaneda: Creating follow-up ticket ENG-RTC-9123 for full RCA, include heap dumps, compile cache logs, and operator runbook updates.

incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. Priority -> P2. Timeline: started 7162504320, mitigated 7162505080. Please update playbook and close after RCA.

support-bot: Notifying affected customers now. Slack channel #cust-C-112 and #cust-C-338 updated.

ashok: Thanks all. If no regressions in 1h, I'll close the incident and schedule postmortem.

kai: note: don't re-enable compile until we validate precompiled kernels; adding to RCA.

maria.castaneda: I'll attach logs and the quick mitigation script to the ticket.

(End of thread)
